  • 英語名: OH!! Micro-Man Chiisaku Natte Onna no Ko no Ironna Tokoro ni Haicchao

あらすじ

One morning, our protagonist, Maikuro Mitsuru, suddenly found himself shrunk to a very small size. Using that to his advantage, he started doing erotic things to various girls. Peeping the toilet and girls’ skirts, sneaking into girls’ clothes and underwear, entering the bathroom as he likes. Thinking everyday about new erotic ideas which can only be done because of his size, he started living a “fulfilling” life.

あらすじ

Akio works at a convenience store. Yukio, his younger brother, always comes to his store after work. He is actually a teacher at a girls school. What they do is to punish girls who committed shoplifting.

One day, Yumi comes to the store and looks for a toilet. Yukio takes her to the toilet and secretly puts an article for sale into her bag. When she comes out, Akio stops her and checks her bag…
